title: SyncVoice: Simple and Effective Automatic Video Dubbing with Vision-Augmented TTS
abstract: arXiv:2512.05126v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Automatic video dubbing aims to generate high-fidelity speech that is temporally aligned with visual content. However, existing methods still suffer from limited speech naturalness, insufficient audio-visual synchronization, and poor scalability beyond monolingual settings. To address these challenges, we propose SyncVoice, a simple and effective dubbing framework that lightly integrates a Text-Visual Fusion Module into a pretrained text-to-speech (TTS) system. This module aligns visual features with linguistic representations, enabling temporally synchronized speech synthesis without complex architectural redesign. Experiments on the LRS3 dataset show that SyncVoice achieves state-of-the-art performance in zero-shot dubbing. Further training on a large-scale bilingual audio-visual dataset improves vocal fidelity while preserving synchronization, yielding a single unified model for both Chinese and English dubbing.

translated_title: SyncVoice：基于视觉增强文本转语音的简单高效自动视频配音
translated_abstract: 自动视频配音旨在生成与视觉内容在时间上对齐的高保真语音。然而，现有方法仍存在语音自然度有限、音视频同步不足以及难以扩展到单语之外场景的问题。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了SyncVoice，一个简单而有效的配音框架，它将文本-视觉融合模块轻量地集成到预训练的文本转语音（TTS）系统中。该模块将视觉特征与语言表示对齐，无需复杂的架构重新设计即可实现时间同步的语音合成。在LRS3数据集上的实验表明，SyncVoice在零样本配音任务中达到了最先进的性能。通过在大规模双语视听数据集上的进一步训练，模型在保持同步性的同时提高了语音保真度，产生了一个同时支持中文和英文配音的统一模型。
tldr: SyncVoice通过在预训练TTS系统中轻量集成文本-视觉融合模块，实现了时间同步的高保真零样本视频配音，并经双语数据训练扩展为统一支持中英文配音的模型。
